Green Valley Organic Bakery

Seattle neighborhood handcrafted artisan bakery since 2014.

Our Story and Philosophy

We source 100% stone-milled regional heritage grains from local Washington organic farms. Every loaf undergoes a slow 36-hour cold fermentation process that develops complex rustic flavor profiles and natural digestibility.
